rows.backtranslation: [Reason] In order for that image-copy to be kept in safekeeping, AN Paint is not now automatically storing a separate image-copy. Store the image-copy which was automatically stored from an earlier time (“File → Export recovery copy…”). Store this image (“File → Save as…”; “File format”: PNG / JPEG).
rows.new_composition: The intended safekeeping purpose uses the already supported complete future storage-state phrase hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz dooleeł followed by source-described purpose biniiyé. It scopes over current negative automatic storage. The prior-copy relative nominal is repeated before its own storage command to distinguish the protected recovery source from the final díí current image. All quoted controls reproduce exact current displays.

semantic_coverage.protection: that image-copy + safekeeping future state + biniiyé expresses purpose, not successful preservation
semantic_coverage.keep_previous: explicit prior automatically stored image-copy object plus manual-storage imperative and recovery ZIP menu citation

Quoted menu labels are deliberately long and verbatim. No shortened menu name or unverified universal Save wording is introduced.
